_doc: The transition vocabulary shared by both engines. A transition is a pure function layer(name, p) -> {rects, circles, alpha, scaleB, aDx, dx...} in normalised units (x/w of frame width, y/h of frame height, circle radius of width), so engine K (Canvas) and engine P (Pillow/numpy) rasterise the *same* geometry. Names/kinds are inspired by the MIT gl-transitions collection (gl-transitions.com), but the maths is vector/CPU so it stays deterministic frame by frame.

notes.reveal: rect mask grows from one edge; diagonal grows column by column
notes.circle: iris opens from the centre (or closes: the mask is inverted)
notes.slide: the incoming frame slides over (cover) or pushes the outgoing one
notes.blinds: vertical slats open from alternating top/bottom edges
notes.checker: tiles pop in on a diagonal stagger
notes.bands: horizontal bands wipe in from alternating sides
notes.zoom: the incoming frame settles from 1.12x while fading in
notes.slices: rows are revealed in a hashed order with a residual horizontal jitter
notes.flash: a quick dip through the paper colour — good for impact cuts
